Name: Bog's Moth Hutch and Critters
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/TPFRHXSS/retro-bookcase-24.png[/img]
This the the first mod where I am collaborating with Aba﻿gaianye to help me keep releasing mods before my upcoming major surgery in December 2025! Huge thanks to Aba, they are doing all the Json work for me so I can focus on making the artwork to continue the BOGGIFICATION OF THE VALLEY!!! 

This mod animates the Butterfly Hutch and retextures it into our new Moth Hutch!
4 different wood config colors
[list]
[*]Bogs[/*]
[*]Black[/*]
[*]White[/*]
[*]Vanilla[/*]
[/list]
With config that also allows you to choose which moth you wanted animated resting on the hutch! We love options hehe
[list]
[*]Atlas Moth[/*]
[*]Brown Moth[/*]
[*]Dead Head Moth[/*]
[*]Luna Moth 1 (green)[/*]
[*]Luna Moth 2 (purple)[/*]
[*]Void Moth[/*]
[/list]
                                                     ﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J7KF1Q77/a25d12d670fbc66481d78c17c1fe5ea7.gif[/img]  

ADDITIONALLY ALL overworld butterflies have been retextured to be replaced with MOTHS! 
[list]
[*]all season moths replaced[/*]
[*]ginger island moths[/*]
[*]AND a special prismatic moth from the Statue of Blessings![/*]
[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/8kyy8Pwj/retro-bookcase-25.png[/img]
[center]See this mod, the entire Bogwood Collection and more in my new youtube series Murkwood Grove!
[youtube]hfF1DBlFluA[/youtube]
[/center]
I highly recommend utilizing

Gwen's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086]Medieval SV Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url] 
DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] 
Aimon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Witchy Dirt and Grass[/url] 

(This is the combination i am using in screenshots & my own playthrough along with all my mods)

to make the rest of the valley look great with my mods<3 As well as 

Morghoula's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12746]Enchanted Grove Farm Map[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url]

<3
Bog
